headline: Brazil Data Center Expansion Faces 14-GW Power and Policy Reality Check
summary: Brazil's data center policy hinges on coordination between parliament and the executive branch to unlock hyperscale investment and address a 14-gigawatt reality check.
why: Data center investments and clean technology policies require complex regulatory coordination between legislative and executive branches in emerging markets.
